text:
Situation: Sodium bicarbonate injection remains on FDA's shortage list for Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. since 2017-03-01 and for Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC since 2017-07-24. Corvale East holds two lots totaling 161 vials of 84 mg/mL 50 mL SDV with 3.4 to 9.2 days supply. Corvale Lakeside has 32 vials with 9.3 days supply. Corvale General holds ample stock of 84 mg/mL and 42 mg/mL presentations with 14.7 to 32.9 days supply.

Why (FDA record): FDA's shortage list shows sodium bicarbonate injection as current for Amphastar Pharmaceuticals, Inc. since 2017-03-01 and for Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC since 2017-07-24. Exela Pharma Sciences, LLC's plant (FEI 3008563008) was classified OAI after an inspection that ended 2024-11-15. Hospira, Inc.'s plant (FEI 1021343) was classified NAI on 2025-02-07. A-S Medication Solutions' plant (FEI 1450743) was classified VAI on 2026-08-12.

Our position: Internal transfers from Corvale General can resolve the immediate shortfall at Corvale East and Corvale Lakeside while maintaining two weeks of supply at the sending site. An approved alternate manufacturer (A-S Medication Solutions) is available for substitution. Two potential suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list but lack identifiable plant information on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Execute transfer of 211 vials of 84 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director transfer request.
2. Execute transfer of 17 vials of 84 mg/mL 50 mL from Corvale General to Corvale Lakeside — requires pharmacy director transfer request.
3. Activate alternate manufacturer substitution to A-S Medication Solutions 84 mg/mL — requires pharmacist approval.
4. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals Private Limited — requires buyer action.
5. Evaluate purchase from Anthea Pharma Private Limited — requires buyer action.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or protocol modifications; those are for treating clinicians and the committee.
